content: One key advantage of our proposed model is the capability of predicting the number of keyphrases conditioned on the given source text. We thus conduct a set of experiments on KP20k and StackEx present keyphrase generation tasks, as shown in Table TABREF39 , to study such behavior. We adopt the self-terminating decoding strategy (Section SECREF28 ), and use both F INLINEFORM0 @ INLINEFORM1 and F INLINEFORM2 @ INLINEFORM3 (Section SECREF4 ) to evaluate.
